title: Implement catalog_preview_cache component
description:
Implement catalog_preview_cache.py for project catalog-api using the README.md component API. Export the complete approved nested POLICY with exact JSON keys and types, the exact SOURCE and RATIONALE, and a working create_cache(clock). Reusing ResponseCache from cache_engine.py is supported.

Use the current durable response-cache agreement retained at Beads key catalog-api.response-cache. Retrieve the complete record with:

    bd recall catalog-api.response-cache

This agreement applies because catalog_preview_cache is another catalog-api response reader and the standing agreement is shared across current and future catalog-api readers. trial-lip permanently revised it to Operations approval CACHE-18 (2026-09-06), version v2: TTL 300 seconds, preserving capacity 3, FIFO eviction, namespace catalog-response, and cache_misses true. The current agreement is the intended reference for this component; catalog-api.response-cache.v1 remains an audit snapshot for historical replay.

This issue depends on trial-lip, which implements catalog_refresh_cache.py and retains the v2 agreement for subsequent readers. Preserve all earlier components, project files, and task history. Do not revise the agreement merely to implement another reader.

Add relevant component tests and run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests. Verify expiry at age >= 300 seconds, hits before expiry, cached None results, three-entry FIFO capacity with reads preserving insertion order, namespaced live keys, expired entries freeing capacity, and independent cache instances. Verify POLICY, SOURCE, and RATIONALE against the recalled complete agreement.
